lines.text: Can I get to Pine Hall by bus?
lines.speaker: Lina

lines.text: Yes. You can take bus six or bus ten.
lines.speaker: Ben

lines.text: Which bus is faster in the morning?
lines.speaker: Lina

lines.text: Bus six takes about ten minutes. Bus ten takes twenty.
lines.speaker: Ben

lines.text: Where do I get off if I take bus six?
lines.speaker: Lina

lines.text: Get off at Market Square. Walk past the market.
lines.speaker: Ben

lines.text: Is the hall next to the market?
lines.speaker: Lina

lines.text: Yes, the entrance is on the left, just past the fruit shop.
lines.speaker: Ben
